title: Many UAP sightings off the coast of San Diego
place_text: Off the coast of San Diego, California

tellings.quote: And just where they are, like a lot are off the coast of San Diego.

plain: On American Alchemy, the podcast hosted by Jesse Michels: a lot of sightings of UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for unexplained things seen in the sky, are said to happen off the coast of San Diego, California, during the years from 2004 onward. The economist Tyler Cowen says this in passing while talking with Michels in 2022, repeating what he has heard from others, and a cluster like that would suggest something keeps coming back to the same stretch of ocean.
